topic: Starbucks was nearly sold in 1987 to Howard Schultz by its founders, who then kept the Seattle store count tiny
title: Starbucks Was Sold for $3.8 Million
note: Gemini first draft, NOT fact-checked. Claude must verify every claim with its own 2-source rule before using any of it in a real job file.
draft_script: Starbucks is a global giant. In 1987, it had six stores. Its founders sold coffee beans. They did not want to sell coffee drinks. Howard Schultz worked there. He saw a different path: cafes. He wanted big expansion. The founders disagreed. They preferred small scale. Schultz made an offer. He bought the Starbucks brand and most stores. The price: $3.8 million. But this was a strange split. The original founders kept a few Seattle locations. They continued their tiny operation. Schultz took the Starbucks name. He built the global empire. A hidden deal that created two companies from one.
